source_semantics.control: Settings.razor exposes the AI prompt templates navigation only inside the Administrator authorization view.
source_semantics.navigation: The control opens /settings/ai-prompts and performs no mutation itself.
source_semantics.side_effects: Navigation does not save prompts, call an AI provider, change WordPress state, enqueue work, or fabricate a success receipt.

laravel_adaptation.frontend: resources/js/settings-ai-prompts-link-control.tsx renders the tenant-scoped AI prompt templates link only for settings.manage users and binds AIMW-AI-0D4D60320B only to that link.
laravel_adaptation.destination: GET /tenants/{tenant}/settings/ai-prompts is wired to the existing AiPromptTemplatesReadController persisted prompt registry surface.
laravel_adaptation.supporting_save_route: PATCH /tenants/{tenant}/settings/ai-prompts/{template} is wired to the existing AiPromptTemplateSaveController because the persisted destination view references that named route; this supporting wiring does not claim the separate Save canonical operation.
laravel_adaptation.authorization: Both destination authorities run behind auth + tenant.context and independently require settings.manage while verifying the active tenant slug.
laravel_adaptation.guard: Users without settings.manage do not receive the Settings navigation control; cross-tenant destination requests fail closed with 404.

tenant_isolation.proof: Focused Laravel acceptance creates separate Alpha and Beta memberships and proves an authenticated Alpha settings manager receives 404 when directly requesting Beta's prompt templates destination.
tenant_isolation.link_scope: The href is generated from the authoritative FrontendContext tenant slug and encodes path-like tenant input instead of accepting a cross-tenant path fragment.

proofs: exact canonical PENDING identity at implementation stage
production canonical operation marker on the real Settings link
persisted prompt templates read authority is the destination
destination GET and supporting PATCH routes use auth and tenant.context
missing settings.manage hides the navigation control
tenant slug is encoded in the generated href
